visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and sunglasses appears in a selfie-perspective on a white boat, pointing a finger upward. Behind her, the water shows a distinct boundary between dark brown and light muddy brown colors. (2) A digital map of Manaus, Brazil, is shown to provide geographical context. (3) The camera shifts to various shots of the river confluence, showing the two-tone water flowing side-by-side. The boat's white railing and red curtains are visible in the foreground. (4) Wide shots capture the vast expanse of the river under a clear blue sky with sparse clouds, highlighting the long line where the waters meet. (5) The camera pans across the horizon, showing the distant forested banks of the Amazon. (6) Closer views of the water surface show small waves and debris floating at the meeting point.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這不是沙灘. [Subtitle]: 是亞馬遜的河流. [Subtitle]: 跟黑河的匯集處. (2) [Logo]: Manaus. (3) [Subtitle]: 在瑪瑙斯最著名的自然現象. [Subtitle]: 是黑河與亞馬遜河匯流. [Subtitle]: 形成的水色交界線. (4) [Subtitle]: 黑河水色呈現深茶褐色. [Subtitle]: 像黑咖啡一樣. [Subtitle]: 水溫大概在28度. [Subtitle]: 酸性較高. [Subtitle]: 含氧量較低. [Subtitle]: 而且溫度也比較高. [Subtitle]: 幾乎沒有蚊子. (5) [Subtitle]: 亞馬遜河呈現泥黃色. [Subtitle]: 溫度在22度. [Subtitle]: 含氧量高. [Subtitle]: 水流快速. [Subtitle]: 因為溫度、水流速度、還有水質酸鹼跟密度都不一樣. [Subtitle]: 所以才形成了這樣的奇觀. [Subtitle]: 兩條河並肩而行了約6公里. [Subtitle]: 才完全混合. [Subtitle]: 可以親眼看到. [Subtitle]: 在亞馬遜雨林這樣的奇觀. [Subtitle]: 我真的覺得非常的幸運. [Subtitle]: 如果有機會. [Subtitle]: 大家也一定要來親眼看一看.
